scope: Reviewed OMAI formula endpoint and exact Lean proof source. Hash and compiled-name checks detect drift and provenance errors; they are not automatic symbolic translation or numerical validation.
interpretations: Positive primitive-cell volume in cubic metres; N_q and N_atoms positive; exactly 3*N_atoms branches, strictly positive frequencies and positive absolute temperature; exact upstream hbar/kB.
Volumetric normalization is sum(c)/(N_q*V_cell) in J/(m^3 K), no Avogadro factor or branch-count divisor. C_vol=C_mol/(N_A*V_cell) uses the same primitive-cell basis.
Actual derivative-defined single-mode Physlib capacities are used. The separate joint-density proof divides the actual joint capacity by N_q*V_cell; it adds no new operator beyond this endpoint.

Exact real Angstrom-cubed and linear-THz interpretation lemmas do not certify floating-point adapters. Cell geometry, dispersion producers, nonuniform q, zero/imaginary modes and thermodynamic limits remain outside scope.
